issues.description: The problem statement incorrectly claims that the DD constructor only takes a single parameter `node: DDNode`, but the actual DD dataclass in dd.py (both template and solution) requires two parameters (node and weight). This mismatch between the problem text and the code may confuse students who follow the prose instead of the code when they attempt to construct DD instances.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to reflect the actual DD constructor signature used in dd.py (DD(node: DDNode, weight: np.complex128)) or remove the incorrect note. For example, replace the sentence with: "If you do directly construct DDs, note that the DD dataclass takes two arguments: node: DDNode and weight: complex." This keeps the textual guidance consistent with the code examples in the template/solution.
